author: Shuang Pan

steps.title: Prepare PCR Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Set up the following reaction on ice to a total volume of 25 ul:

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 units of Taq DNA polymerase
Add sterile Tris-distilled water to reach the final volume

steps.title: Perform PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Carry out the amplification in a Tetrad Thermal Cycle using the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Run 30 cycles of: denaturation at 94℃ for 30 sec, annealing at 58℃ for 30 sec, and extension at 72℃ for 1 min

steps.title: Analyze PCR Products
steps.instruction: Electrophorese the amplified products and visualize the results.

substeps.instruction: Run products on a 1.5% agarose gel in Tris-acetate buffer (40 mM Tris acetate, 1 mM EDTA, pH 8.0)
Visualize products with ethidium bromide using UV transillumination
